description: Calculates simple interest using the formula: Interest = Principal × Rate × Time. Rate should be provided as a percentage and time in years. (cost: 1 credit)

interest_rate.description: number, required, annual interest rate as a percentage (e.g., 5 for 5%)

principal_amount.description: number, required, principal amount in currency units

time_period.description: number, required, time period in years

name: calculate_interest
